# RAR test fixtures — provenance

Consumed by `tests/rar_extract.rs` and `tests/sprint6_fuzz.rs`.

RAR is **extract-only** for OtterZip (the RARLAB UnRAR licence forbids using the
source to develop a RAR-compatible archiver), so unlike every other backend we
cannot author these with our own writer. Hence: copied, or derived by patching a
copied one.

## Copied verbatim from the `unrar` crate

Source: [`unrar` 0.5.8](https://github.com/muja/unrar.rs) `data/` directory —
`MIT OR Apache-2.0` (see `crates/LICENSE-MIT`, `crates/LICENSE-APACHE`).
Copyright (c) Danyel Bayraktar. Copied under the terms of the MIT licence.

Note this is the **`unrar` wrapper crate**, which is genuinely MIT/Apache — not
`unrar_sys`, which vendors RARLAB's C++ and whose self-declared licence is
wrong. Nothing here is derived from the UnRAR source.

| Fixture | Format | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| `version.rar` | RAR3 | Plain single entry (`VERSION`, 11 B, `"unrar-0.4.0"`) |
| `crypted.rar` | RAR3 | Entry-encrypted, password `unrar`. **The wrong-password heuristic's only fixture** |
| `comment-hpw-password.rar` | RAR5 | `-hp` header-encrypted, password `password` |
| `archive.part1.rar` | RAR3 | Multi-volume, deliberately **incomplete** → `MissingVolume` |
| `100M.part00002.rar` | RAR5 | Non-first volume, ships without its part 1 |
| `solid.rar` | RAR5 | Solid block |
| `unicode.rar` | RAR5 | Non-ASCII entry name (`te…―st✌`) |
| `utf8.rar` | RAR5 | Non-ASCII entry name (`foo—bar`), zero-length body |

## Generated by `tools/make-rar-fixtures.py`

Each is `version.rar` with **one field** of its RAR3 file header patched and the
header CRC recomputed (`crc32(header[2..HEAD_SIZE]) & 0xFFFF` — the script
re-derives the pristine file's stored CRC first, as a self-check). Real unrar
reads them all back, which is the point: unrar's own parser is the judge of
whether the input we claim to defend against is actually reachable.

Regenerate with `python tools/make-rar-fixtures.py`.

| Fixture | Patch | Documents |
|---|---|---|
| `traversal.rar` | name → `..\..\a` | `..` **survives unrar's own cleaning** — our guard is the only defence, not belt-and-braces |
| `backslash.rar` | name → `a\b\c.t` | RAR really stores `\`; must normalise to `/`, not reject as traversal |
| `absolute.rar` | name → `C:\ev.t` | unrar rewrites the drive colon (returns `C_\ev.t`), so our colon check is *not* what saves us here |
| `symlink.rar` | attr → `0xa1ff` | `S_IFLNK\|0777` — the exact bits unrar derives `FSREDIR_UNIXSYMLINK` from (`arcread.cpp:307-309`) |
| `bigdecl.rar` | `UNP_SIZE` → 100 MiB | A header that **lies**: 100 MiB declared over 11 real bytes. `extract_entry` used to branch on this number and stage anything over 64 MiB through `%TEMP%`, letting unrar prealloc the declared size — an attacker-chosen disk cost on `Archive::test`. Pins that no size branch remains |
